configurations.comment: The web preview. If 8081 is already taken, stop whatever holds it rather than adding a second config on another port — Expo CLI ignores an assigned PORT env var and binds its own default regardless, so any alternative port has to be passed as an explicit --port flag with autoPort:false to match, and a spare config per parallel session is how this file grew a tail.
configurations.name: expo-web

configurations.comment: Same as expo-web but resets Metro's transform cache. EXPO_PUBLIC_* vars are inlined at transform time, so editing .env does NOT take effect on a plain restart — use this after changing one.
configurations.name: expo-web-clear

configurations.comment: Metro for a physical device over LAN. Needs a dev build installed (react-native-maps / react-native-zip-archive are not in Expo Go). Scan the QR or open the exp+bucket-hat://expo-development-client URL from preview_logs.
configurations.name: expo-mobile
